instruction.text: You are facing towards the wooden wall, move forward towards the wooden wall, turn right there is a  sofa to your right side and a TV on the wall to your left side, move forward walking between them. There is a dinning table to your right side, move forward towards the dinning table, slightly turn left you are in the kitchen, move forward towards the fridge. There is a oven and stove to your left side and a wash basin to your right side, move forward walking between them, move forward towards the step, walk all the way to the top of the steps, you are facing the wall with paintings on it, slightly turn left, stand near the painting, this is your final destination.
